name: modern-bulk-rail-loader-pooled
title: Modern Bulk Rail Loaders: Pooled
author: Sølve Monteiro
description: Bulk train loading/unloading silos that share a single pooled inventory per station. Contents can never get unbalanced between wagons, so automated deliveries (e.g. Cybersyn) always complete when the station total suffices. Pooled-architecture rework inspired by Modern Bulk Rail Loader by Vyl.
